accountant_is_configured.meaning: the Vault has an Accountant configured

active_registration_exists_for_target_sl.meaning: an active registration exists for the target BLP slot

slot_is_activated_strict_read.meaning: the registered slot is an activated strict-read slot dereferenceable by Accountant backing reads

total_backing_signed_reverts_occurred.meaning: a later totalBackingSigned()/distributableSurplus()/settleDailyPnL() call reverts before removeSuppliedEntry clears the entry
total_backing_signed_reverts_occurred.checkpoint: after supplyToBlp registration, before removeSuppliedEntry cleanup

assumptions: The operator calls supplyToBlp on the target BLP slot after the preconditions hold.
The reported revert is conditional (potential) and only asserted for the scenario where the slot remains unreadable.

unresolved.description: Report does not establish that the registered slot is actually dereferenced by Accountant backing reads in this scenario, nor the exact suppliedBalance read/expected value; the activation obligation is represented as a Boolean without a numeric binding.
Whether HyperCore activation is synchronous or asynchronous, and thus whether the slot can remain unreadable after supplyToBlp, is not established.

limitations: The impact is potential; the plan encodes the conditional scenario, not an inevitable revert.
The activation obligation is a qualitative Boolean because the report gives no numeric strict-read definition.
Authorization of the operator is not claimed; no permissionless-caller scope is encoded.
